limitations: One paired software-emulator run; repeat adverse/noisy cases before acceptance.
An identical-APK control measures environment variation and cannot accept a new renderer.
HWUI quantiles cover its recent CSV ring; actual presentation polling covers the complete motion.
PSS trend is a short bounded soak, not proof of indefinite memory stability.
Separate interaction/upgrade/save smoke and visual review are required before the phase gate.
No fixed physical-device FPS or isolated hardware GPU utilization claimed.

findings: Failed producer-side consumer calls disappeared but actual presentations slowed substantially.
P50 grew roughly1.76–2.58x across the complete matrix; pan and zoom-out P95 increased83.46% and87.42%.
Favorable staged LOD frame-duration quantiles and bounded memory do not override continuous-gesture regression.
nextHypothesis: Test HWUI consumer ownership together with asynchronous EGL submission, isolated from gameplay. Buffer queue causation is not established by these metrics alone.
